resources.string: Your phone may stop %1$s in the background to save battery, which pauses your blocks. Follow these steps for your phone.
See steps for your phone on dontkillmyapp.com

string-array.name: sf_battery_steps_xiaomi
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Apps, then Manage apps, then %1$s.
Turn on Autostart.
Tap Battery saver and choose No restrictions.
In Recent apps, lock %1$s so it is not cleared.

string-array.name: sf_battery_steps_oppo
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Battery, then %1$s.
Allow background activity and allow auto launch.
In Recent apps, lock %1$s so it is not cleared.

string-array.name: sf_battery_steps_vivo
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Battery, then Background power consumption.
Choose %1$s and allow high background power use.
Allow Autostart for %1$s in Settings, then Apps.

string-array.name: sf_battery_steps_samsung
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Battery, then Background usage limits.
Remove %1$s from Sleeping apps and Deep sleeping apps.
Open Settings, then Apps, then %1$s, then Battery, and choose Unrestricted.

string-array.name: sf_battery_steps_oneplus
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Battery, then Battery optimization.
Choose %1$s and select Don\'t optimize.
In Recent apps, lock %1$s so it is not cleared.

string-array.name: sf_battery_steps_huawei
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Battery, then App launch.
Turn off Manage automatically for %1$s.
Turn on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.

string-array.name: sf_battery_steps_default
string-array.item: Open the battery settings below.
Find %1$s and choose Don\'t optimize or Unrestricted.
If your phone has an autostart or background-activity setting, allow it for %1$s.
